regex_help.body_name_replacement:
NAME REPLACEMENT REGEX HELP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This app uses Go's regexp package, which implements RE2 syntax.
RE2 guarantees linear-time matching and supports UTF-8.

For interactive testing and syntax reference, visit regex101.com
or other regex testing tools (select "Golang" as the flavor when testing patterns).


ANCHORS
  ^  Matches start of name    $  Matches end of name
  Example: ^IAM matches "IAM Servers"  |  Prod$ matches "Web-Prod"


CAPTURE GROUPS
  (.*)   Captures any characters (greedy)
  (.+?)   Captures any characters (non-greedy)
  $1, $2  Reference captured text in the replacement


EXAMPLES (single rule)
  Pattern: ^IAM (.*)     Replacement: MyOrg $1
  Source: "IAM Servers"   → Result: "MyOrg Servers"

  Pattern: ^Corp-(.*)$   Replacement: MyOrg-$1
  Source: "Corp-Prod"    → Result: "MyOrg-Prod"

  Pattern: ^(DEV|QA)-    Replacement: Staging-
  Source: "DEV-Server1"   → Result: "Staging-Server1"


MULTIPLE RULES (chained)
  Rules run in order: output of rule 1 becomes input to rule 2, etc.

  Rule 1: Pattern: ^IAM (.*)     Replacement: MyOrg $1
  Rule 2: Pattern: (.*) extended  Replacement: $1 detail

  Source: "IAM Servers extended"
  After rule 1: "MyOrg Servers extended"
  After rule 2: "MyOrg Servers detail"

  You can mix chained rules (e.g. rename prefix) with unrelated rules
  (e.g. rename suffix) in the same list.


CASE INSENSITIVITY
  Use (?i) at the start of the pattern for case-insensitive matching:

  Pattern: (?i)^iam (.*)   Replacement: MyOrg $1
  Matches: "IAM Servers", "iam servers", "IAm Servers" → "MyOrg Servers"


TIPS
  • Rules run in order; output of rule 1 is input to rule 2
  • Escape special chars: . * + [ ] ( ) | etc. use backslash
  • If pattern doesn't match, name is left unchanged
  • Validate patterns before migration—invalid regex blocks start
regex_help.body_browse_filter:
BROWSE & SELECT REGEX FILTER HELP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When the "Regex" checkbox is enabled in Browse & Select, the search box
uses Go's regexp package (RE2 syntax) to match the visible row text (for
Sensors and Packages, that includes content set / last-saved text and the object name).

With Regex OFF, search is simple case-insensitive substring match on that same combined text.
With Regex ON, use full patterns for precise matching.


COMMON EXAMPLES
  IAM
    Matches any item containing "IAM"

  ^IAM Asset.*
    Matches names that start with "IAM Asset"

  (?i)^iam a[ip]
    Case-insensitive start match; matches "IAM A..." with next char i or p

  (Cloud|AWS).*
    Matches either Cloud... or AWS...


ANCHORS
  ^   Start of name
  $   End of name

CASE INSENSITIVITY
  Prefix pattern with (?i), for example:
    (?i)^iam

INVALID PATTERNS
  If a regex is invalid, the dialog shows an inline "Invalid regex" message.
  No items are matched until the pattern is corrected.

TIPS
  • Select All applies only to items matching the CURRENT filter
  • Deselect matching clears selection only for items matching the current filter (visible rows)
  • Deselect All clears the entire selection (all items), including hidden rows
  • Sensors/Packages lists: second column prefers content set (e.g. Content: Tanium Standard); if missing, “Last saved:” user (not original author; Component Updater touches many objects)
  • Escape special characters when needed: \. \* \+ \[ \] \( \)
  • Use regex101 with Golang flavor for quick testing

tooltips.start_migration: Run one coordinated migration: every checked component on both the Core (Phase 1) and Modules (Phase 2) tabs, in the tool's built-in dependency order (not the order tabs were opened). Unchecked items are skipped. Browse & Select lists still apply where used.
tooltips.export_to_file: Write the current export manifest and selected component data to disk (for backup, CLI import, or moving to another environment).
tooltips.import_from_file: Import a previously exported bundle from disk onto the connected target (respects export manifest and order).
tooltips.mark_checklist: After you finish migrating this module, mark its checklist section complete so you can track progress.
tooltips.view_log: Open the live migration log in a separate window (resize or copy text as needed).
tooltips.connect_server: Test this server with the URL and credentials above (source: read access; target: write access).
tooltips.disconnect_side: Clear the connection status for this side only; the URL and credentials remain in the form.
tooltips.clear_recent_servers: Remove all entries from this side's recent-servers list (not the current URL field).
tooltips.enable_debug: Choose a log file; detailed debug output is written there for this session (troubleshooting).
tooltips.swap_source_target: Swap source and target connection fields (URL, auth, recent pick, throttling) in one step.
tooltips.open_checklist: Open the migration checklist window to track phases and components.
tooltips.diff_compare: Compare configuration between source and target (see product documentation for scope).
tooltips.export_cli_config: Save a JSON description of enabled components for headless or CLI sync.
tooltips.verify_tls: Validate TLS certificate trust for both servers without running a migration.
tooltips.auto_skip_duplicates: When enabled, duplicates on the target are skipped automatically instead of prompting.
tooltips.api_throttle: Add a short delay between API calls (often helpful on Tanium Cloud / TitanKube rate limits).
tooltips.add_name_rule: Add another regex pattern/replacement row for renaming objects during migration.
tooltips.browse_select: Pick specific source items when the checkbox is enabled (optional selective migration).
tooltips.select_csv: Choose a CSV file; use the document icon for a sample template where offered.
tooltips.csv_sample: Generate or reveal a sample CSV you can edit and use with Select CSV File.
tooltips.browse_platform_users: Choose source Tanium users whose content sets, computer groups, user groups, and personas on the target should match the source (users must already exist on the target).
tooltips.export_select_all_components: Checks every exportable category on the Core (Phase 1) and Modules (Phase 2) tabs in one step, so you can run a full export without touching those checkboxes first. You can also leave this off and enable only the components you need. Browse & Select lists are not changed; when a list is empty, export still includes all items in that category.
tooltips.module_tab: Open "{{module}}" on this tab — components, checkboxes, and Browse & Select for that module.
tooltips.stop_migration: Request cancellation of the current migration. In-flight work stops at the next safe point; a large API call in progress may take a few seconds to finish.
tooltips.remember_token: Off (default): token is held only for this session. On: store in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Linux Secret Service). Without a Linux Secret Service, you'll be asked whether to fall back to plaintext or stay session-only.
tooltips.debug_turn_off: Debug output is being written to a file. Click to stop debug output, close the log, and return to the idle state. You can enable logging to a new file afterward.
tooltips.file_debug_header_on: File debug active — turn off and close the log. Same as Turn off on Server Configuration.
tooltips.file_debug_header_pick: Choose a file for [DEBUG] log output. Same as Enable Debug Logging on Server Configuration.
tooltips.file_debug_header_cons: Console debug only; click to add file logging for this session.
tooltips.debug_status_file_on: Detailed [DEBUG] output is being written to your log file. Use the icon in the header or Turn off on Server Configuration.
tooltips.debug_status_file_off: No session log file. Use the file icon in the header or Server Configuration to choose a file.
tooltips.debug_status_console: The app was started with console debug; output goes to the terminal. Use the file icon in the header to add file logging to a file.
tooltips.cleanup_exports_logs: Securely delete export folders, manifests, debug logs, and other tool-produced files from the app launch directory (or any directory you Browse to). Per-file opt-in; selected files are overwritten with random bytes (best effort, ≤256 MiB) before unlink. Use at engagement end.
tooltips.browse_computer_groups_list_only: List rows returned by GET /api/v2/groups that the main console grid omits (mrgroup_* merged groups and management_rights_flag false). For lab verification only—does not change migration selection; normal Browse & Select stays console-grid parity.

tooltips.import_language_packs: Import additional UI language packs from a tanium-geminatus-language-packs.zip file. Useful for standalone-binary users who don't have language files alongside the executable.

credstore.fallback_body:
No system keychain is reachable on this host ({{os}}). The {{side}} API token for {{url}} can be either:

  A) Kept in memory for this session only (secure default). You'll re-enter the token next launch.

  B) Stored in plaintext in the application preferences file under your user's app data directory. Anyone (or anything) running as you on this host can read it.

Choose B only if you understand the exposure and the host is dedicated to your engagement.
